rendered: In the passive-targeting section of the nanocarrier table, the systems with a particle size at or above the threshold are: the KRAS siRNA TGF-β siRNA[1] system (PLGA/PLA carrier) at ~180 nm[2]; the VEGFR2 siRNA mTOR siRNA[3] system (sEVs) at ~150 nm[4]; the siTEAD4[5] system (MOF@EVs) at ~168 nm[6]; and the DDP siVEGF[7] system (MOF carrier, VEGF target) at ~485 nm[8]. The largest is therefore the DDP system, at about ~485 nm[9].
expect: the PLGA/PLA/PCL polymer system (~180 nm), sEVs (~150 nm), MOF@EVs (~168 nm) and MOF (~485 nm, the largest); passive targeting covers the rows down to GO (active targeting)
